### Problem Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Open https://www.starpi.app (or `npm run dev`)
2. Choose the model (a cloud provider with your key, a free model of the site, your server, a model on this device (WebGPU or WASM), the companion, or Auto) and the mode (Auto, Free or Grounded)
3. Add the file or ask the question that triggers the problem
4. Inspect the error in the console

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
